name: engine-core
description: Pure helpers every engine shares: seeded Rng/forkRng, Result/Status, text cleaning (cleanName, clampInt), ids and tokens, player palette, per-viewer view helpers, and vitest contract helpers (determinism, JSON-safe, no-leak).
notes: Import it as @game/engine: the generated game's engine package re-exports it.
engine/contract.ts imports vitest, so it is not in the index; import it directly from tests.
